# One command per line, run in order by .github/workflows/expo-upgrade.yml
# Batch 3: missing peer dependencies; check whether @expo/config-plugins is still needed; try an iOS prebuild.
npx expo install expo-constants expo-haptics expo-linear-gradient
npm uninstall @expo/config-plugins
npx expo config --type prebuild --json > /dev/null && echo CONFIG_OK_WITHOUT_CONFIG_PLUGINS || { echo NEED_CONFIG_PLUGINS; npx expo install @expo/config-plugins; }
npx expo prebuild --platform ios --no-install --clean > /tmp/prebuild.log 2>&1 && echo PREBUILD_OK || echo PREBUILD_FAILED; tail -40 /tmp/prebuild.log
grep -n "SceneDelegate\|UIApplicationSceneManifest" -r ios --include=*.plist --include=*.swift -l | head
ls ios
